title: LayerZero channel for deployments can be blocked due to reverts
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** Medium  **Likelihood:** Medium  ## Description  The `LayerZeroDeployer` contract uses LayerZero v1, which has a blocking nature by default, and its receiver function doesn't implement a non-blocking pattern. Any revert during the cross-chain execution will block the whole channel, preventing future DAO deployments, until the protocol admin unlocks it via `forceResume()`.
